monitor_the_situation.title: Yemeni Armed Forces Strike Saudi Military Gatherings in Sanaa

— S3 · Conflict · Sanaa, Yemen · 56m ago. Yemeni Armed Forces, including Ansarallah, launched new attacks against Saudi military gatherings, indicating continued conflict despite recent truce efforts.
Saudi Arabia Depletes Patriot Interceptors in Iran War
— S3 · Conflict · Riyadh, Saudi Arabia · 1h ago. Saudi Arabia used 86% of its 2,800 Patriot PAC-3 interceptors in the first 38 days of combat in the Iran War, leaving only 400 by April.
Yemen Naval Forces Stop Attack on Oil Tanker in Red Sea
— S3 · Conflict · Red Sea · 2h ago. Yemen's naval forces say they intercepted and halted an attack on an oil tanker in the Red Sea. The assailants and vessel's condition are not yet confirmed.
